images.longuedorse-adult:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for the original 2D military science-fiction side-scrolling game ORDRE DE CENDRE.
Style: sophisticated hand-painted game sprites, detailed tactile matte surfaces, precise silhouettes, soft restrained upper-left illumination, grounded believable alien ecology and functional engineering. Orthographic SIDE view, facing RIGHT. Flat side projection, NOT isometric or a 3/4 perspective. True transparent alpha everywhere outside isolated sprites. NO scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, border, panel background, grid lines, captions, text, numbers or watermark. Every cell has generous transparent padding and its sprite stays entirely inside it. Absolutely no overlap between cells. The following reading order is LEFT to RIGHT then TOP to BOTTOM. Consistent scale, anatomy and identity across states.
Create a LANDSCAPE atlas with EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS and 2 ROWS, EIGHT equal cells.
Subject FU07 LONGUE-DORSE ADULT, the SAME peaceful alien migratory grazer in each cell. Low long rounded heavy back with five broad parallel vertical ridges, soft olive-sage and brown-violet hide, pale ivory textured lower legs and broad blunt muzzle on RIGHT, tiny black eye, two small leaf-shaped ears/horns, short curled tail LEFT, six pale culture-spore nodules along flank. FOUR legs only (two near, two farther darker), wide soft hooves, no human rider or gear. Recognizably alien, gentle and weighty, neither dinosaur nor horse. Body about 1.6 times as long as total standing height.
ROW 1: waiting standing all hooves grounded; walk phase0 left-near forefoot reaching forward; walk phase1 near forefoot taking weight and opposite hindfoot lifting; walk phase2 opposite forefoot forward; 
ROW 2: walk phase3 compressed weight transfer with the first hoof lifted; arrived calm grazing with head lowered slightly and feet planted; diverted alert side-on with head raised while looking right, still all legs on ground; dead resting on side collapsed with eyes closed, no gore.
All eight full bodies face RIGHT. Four walk frames form clear different consecutive phases of a slow walking cycle, no sliding duplicate poses. Same body scale, back dimensions and foot baseline in the seven live states. Dead frame lower silhouette, original body length preserved. No grass, rocks or visual effects.

Subject FU08 EVENTAIL DE THYR, a small colony of THREE non-terrestrial pollinators. Each creature is a rounded fan-shaped translucent sage membrane with five visible pale ivory radial ribs converging into a small dark green central body, subtle pale violet edges, no bird head, no bird wings, no insect legs. Same three organisms in every living cell. No perch object.
ROW1: settled cluster, three open fan membranes near shared baseline, middle slightly higher; airborne flutter phase0 with outer membranes spread, colony slightly above baseline; airborne phase1 membranes folding gently edgeward.
ROW2: airborne phase2 open membranes tilted apart and upward; airborne phase3 intermediate folded membranes descending; lost colony as three small collapsed folded dry membrane remains near baseline, no gore.

Subject FL07 COLONNE-MERE of THYR, enormous hollow living load-bearing plant. A tall straight vertically ribbed green-brown-violet fibrous column trunk with a narrow hollow slit, spreading buttress base and broad overlapping pale sage ribbed canopy fronds at the TOP, canopy silhouette roughly four times trunk width, trunk from base to canopy about four times its width. Visible structural fibers and believable weight. No houses, people, vines or ground terrain. The column will support a separately placed suspended house.
ROW1: one complete intact tall COLUMN; EXACT same column damaged with localized splintered bark mid-trunk, canopy retained, silhouette and height unchanged; same column destroyed, SHORT splintered hollow stump about one quarter original height, fallen fragments only at its foot, no floating canopy.
ROW2: second coherent silhouette variation intact column with asymmetrical canopy; matching damaged state same height; matching destroyed short stump.
Each intact/damaged column full height with base at same baseline and same scale in every cell; destroyed states remain smaller in same cell rather than enlarged. Fine lighting without shadows outside silhouette. Large top canopy fully within each cell. No miniature forest, no scene.
